_comment: INDUSTRIAL: a stencilled placard - a pale painted panel carrying three block bars (a unit number) and a hazard diamond. FLAT decal geometry on purpose: it is the marking class, and a piece two centimetres proud lies on ANY seat, which is what makes it the kit's thin-shape carrier. NO yellow, deliberately - the kit's yellow is disciplined to edges, collars and handles, so the diamond is dark ink on pale primer rather than a fourth use of the accent. The bars are offset a little off a common centre line because a stencil is sprayed by a fitter, not printed. Long axis is +Z so `align: Run` reads the number down the plate run.
